verdict.rationale: The public docs cover each step an API-key-holding agent needs. There is an auth test endpoint (GET /v2/jobs/auth), job creation by URL or direct upload, and a read endpoint that returns status and results as JSON, SRT or VTT. Webhooks and SSE cover completion without polling, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published at /openapi.json. Missing for 10: the exact auth header/scheme is not shown in the evidence, there is no hands-on or independent end-to-end corroboration, and llms.txt and markdown docs return 404.
